aiOverview.content: In a close April 6, 2026 contest, the New York Knicks defeated the Atlanta Hawks 108-105, led by Jalen Brunson's 30 points and 13 assists, including 17 points in the fourth quarter. Karl-Anthony Towns added 21 points and 12 rebounds for the Knicks, while Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 36 for Atlanta. New York Knicks (108) vs. Atlanta Hawks (105) - April 6, 2026 Jalen Brunson (NYK): 30 pts, 13 ast, 11/26 FG Karl-Anthony Towns (NYK): 21 pts, 12 reb, 6 ast, 9/12 FG OG Anunoby (NYK): 22 pts, 7/14 FG Mikal Bridges (NYK): 15 pts, 7/13 FG Nickeil Alexander-Walker (ATL): 36 pts, 20 in first half, 3-for-4 from three Jalen Johnson (ATL): 21 pts, 11 reb, 48th double-double Dyson Daniels (ATL): 11 pts, 12 reb CJ McCollum (ATL): 17 pts Key Game Statistics Third Quarter: The Knicks outscored the Hawks 28-22, fueled by 14 points from Karl-Anthony Towns, taking an 81-79 lead. Fourth Quarter: Jalen Brunson dominated the fourth with 17 points to secure the win. Ending: A potential buzzer-beating shot by CJ McCollum was reviewed and ruled no good, confirming the Knicks' 51st win. Absences: Knicks played without Josh Hart and Deuce McBride.
